g.text: Graph revision AD - stack01: The PEM cell field: 80 bipolar plates of 169.7 x 169.7 mm active between Ti end plates at the 8 mm pitch; the plates and lands draw, the MEAs are a BOM loading row (W12(3))
Graph revision AD - stack01: The cell-summed area 2.304 m2 is what the rated H2 books: 26,590 Ah/kg / j (A-M-459)
Graph revision AD - stack01: Copper bus pair at the terminals (dry side; conductors are copper per duty section 3); 518.4 A per terminal pair
Graph revision AD - stack01: The operating point (j 1.8 A/cm2, 1.85 V/cell) is the registered study basis - the polarisation curve replaces it at the first article (W12(2))
